definition.geometry: Photo-informed shroud and head casting; manufacturer-referenced control layout. Dimensions remain approximate. Not CAD.
definition.behavior: Local illustrative practice only. No optical, payload or hardware calibration.

components.label: Sliding camera plate
components.purpose: Moves the complete payload fore and aft over the head’s tilt axis.
components.action: Support the rig, release the captured slide and adjust near level. Nose heavy: move rearward. Tail heavy: move forward. Secure the plate before tilting.

components.label: Slide lock lever
components.purpose: Secures the camera plate. The removal position also requires the safety button.
components.action: Cartoni positions: 0 locked, 1 captured sliding, 2 removal. Use captured sliding for balance and return to 0 afterwards.

components.label: Tilt drag selector
components.purpose: Sets resistance during up/down camera movement.
components.action: This is the left control you circled. Reduce drag for balancing; add the operating feel after the rig holds its angle.
components.note: Drag controls motion resistance; counterbalance supports the load.

components.label: Pan lock lever
components.purpose: Locks left/right rotation of the head.
components.action: This is the right control you circled. Keep pan locked while mounting and balancing, then release it for operation.

components.label: Pan drag selector
components.purpose: Sets resistance during horizontal camera movement.
components.action: Release the pan lock, then set a comfortable drag for the focal length and shot.

components.label: Tilt lock lever
components.action: Support the camera before releasing it. A locked head cannot reveal whether the rig is balanced.

components.label: Horizontal lock
components.purpose: The on/off buttons hold the head at its horizontal mounting position.
components.action: Engage at level for setup. Hold the pan bar firmly before disengaging the horizontal lock.

components.label: Counterbalance selector
components.purpose: Adjusts the spring torque opposing the weight of the tilted payload.
components.action: After fore/aft balance, increase counterbalance until the rig holds both upward and downward angles. Too little falls farther; too much returns toward level.
components.note: Rear of the head, above the PAN / BALANCE / TILT readouts.

components.label: Pan / balance / tilt readouts
components.purpose: Displays head settings with an illumination button.
components.action: Use as a repeatable reference after balance is established. No real setting number is prescribed for this unknown payload.

components.label: Bubble level
components.purpose: Shows whether the head base is level.
components.action: Level the support before balancing and check it again after repositioning.

frame.origin: head base contact plane on pan axis

dimensions.use: approximate inspection only; not measured fit

counterbalance.meaning: relative illustrative value; no physical spring calibration
